[EN] You don't look hurt. Not badly, anyway.
[ES] No te ves herido. No de gravedad, al menos.

[EN] Stay alert! There could be anything on this island.
[ES] ¡Mantente alerta! Podría haber cualquier cosa en esta isla.

[EN] Hold on. Breathe deeply. That's it.
[ES] Espera. Respira hondo. Así.

[EN] The horrors, the horrors.
[ES] Los horrores, los horrores.

[EN] We just found medical supplies. Waterlogged, but usable.
[ES] Acabamos de encontrar suministros médicos. Empapados, pero utilizables.
